description: The bar chart, titled "QLoRA," illustrates the number of floating-point operations across different computational methods. The horizontal axis contains the categories, with labels angled downwards. The vertical value axis is labeled "# FLOPs" and utilizes a logarithmic scale. The axis ranges from $10^{18}$ to $10^{20}$, with major numeric tick labels positioned at intervals of one order of magnitude ($10^{18}$, $10^{19}$, $10^{20}$), accompanied by light horizontal grid lines. The chart consists of six vertical bars. The first five bars are colored orange: "Full FT" is the tallest bar overall at approximately $6 \times 10^{19}$, followed by "TAG" at roughly $4 \times 10^{19}$, "LoRA" at approximately $2.5 \times 10^{19}$, "MTL-FT" at about $9 \times 10^{18}$, and "QLoRA," which is the shortest bar on the chart, at approximately $4.5 \times 10^{18}$. The final bar is labeled "Ours" and has an approximate value of $5 \times 10^{18}$. The bars are generally arranged in descending order of value from left to right, with the exception of the final bar, which is slightly taller than the preceding one. Visual emphasis is applied to the "Ours" category; its label on the horizontal axis is bolded, and the bar is colored green, distinguishing it from the orange bars of the other categories.
